description: Create the complete data-access layer (Backend/src/db/) with one query file per entity, replacing all Mongoose model calls (Steps D and partial E). Also create the isValidUUID utility. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 (supabase.js must exist). The db layer is the foundation that all service migrations in FEAT-003 will import.
steps: Create Backend/src/utils/isValidUUID.js: exports a single function `function isValidUUID(id) { return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(String(id || '')); } module.exports = { isValidUUID };`

Create Backend/src/db/clinic.db.js: exports getDefaultClinic() which does `supabase.from('clinics').select('*').limit(1).single()` and returns the clinic row (or creates one if none exists using supabase.from('clinics').insert([{...}]).select().single()). All services call this instead of their own getDefaultClinic().

Create Backend/src/db/user.db.js: exports findByEmail(email) [includes password_hash via select('*, password_hash')], findById(id), findDoctors({status}) [WHERE role='doctor' AND status=$1], findAllStaff() [all users], createUser(data) [insert + return new row], updateUser(id, data) [update by id], updateLastLogin(id) [update last_login_at=NOW()].

Create Backend/src/db/treatment-category.db.js: exports findAll(filter) [search with ILIKE on name, filter by is_active, sort], findById(id), findByCode(code), create(data) [insert], update(id, data) [update], toggleActive(id, isActive) [update is_active], upsertByCode(code, clinicId, data) [upsert with onConflict('clinic_id,code') for seed use].

Create Backend/src/db/patient.db.js: exports findAll(filter) with LEFT JOINs to users (AS assigned_doctor) and treatment_categories; filter by is_deleted=false, ILIKE search across name/phone/patient_number/email/chief_complaint, filter by assigned_doctor_id and treatment_category_id; returns paginated result. Also exports findById(id) [with same JOINs], findByPatientNumber(patientNumber), create(data) [insert; DO NOT pass patient_number — let sequence generate it; use INSERT ... RETURNING * to get generated patient_number back], update(id, data), softDelete(id) [update is_deleted=true, deleted_at=NOW()].

Create Backend/src/db/appointment.db.js: exports findAll(query) with LEFT JOINs to patients/users/treatment_categories; supports view filter (today/missed/upcoming), status/priority/doctorId/categoryId/date filters, sort, pagination. Filter out appointments where patients.is_deleted=true in the JOIN. Also exports findById(id) [with JOINs], findByPatient(patientId) [with JOINs, sort by start_at DESC], findRemindersToSend(tomorrowStart, tomorrowEnd) [WHERE start_at BETWEEN $1 AND $2 AND status IN ('scheduled','confirmed') AND is_deleted=false AND reminder_sent=false], create(data) [insert; DO NOT pass appointment_number — let sequence generate; RETURNING *], updateStatus(id, updateFields) [update arbitrary fields], softDelete(id) [is_deleted=true, deleted_at=NOW()], bulkSoftDeleteByPatient(patientId) [UPDATE appointments SET is_deleted=true, status='cancelled', deleted_at=NOW() WHERE patient_id=$1 AND is_deleted=false], checkOverlap(doctorId, startAt, endAt) [SELECT id FROM appointments WHERE doctor_id=$1 AND is_deleted=false AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rescheduled','completed','missed') AND start_at < $3 AND end_at > $2 LIMIT 1].

Create Backend/src/db/clinical-record.db.js: exports findByPatient(patientId) [WHERE patient_id=$1 AND is_deleted=false ORDER BY visit_date DESC], findById(id), create(data) [insert with dental_chart as JS array — Supabase serializes to JSONB automatically], update(id, data).

Create Backend/src/db/invoice.db.js: exports create(invoiceData) [insert invoice, return new row with id], createWithItems(invoiceData, items) [insert invoice then insert items into invoice_items with the new invoice id as FK; use sequential awaits not a transaction — single-clinic app, low concurrency acceptable for MVP].

Create Backend/src/db/payment.db.js: exports findAll(filter) [with LEFT JOIN to patients for patient name/number], findByPatient(patientId) [sort by paid_at DESC], create(data) [insert; DO NOT pass receipt_number — sequence generates; RETURNING *], softDelete(id), getRevenueSummary(clinicId) [SELECT method, SUM(amount) AS value FROM payments WHERE clinic_id=$1 AND is_deleted=false GROUP BY method].
Create Backend/src/db/file.db.js: exports create(data) [insert file metadata], findById(id).

Create Backend/src/db/ai-report.db.js: exports create(data) [insert], findByPatient(patientId) [LEFT JOIN files ON files.id=ai_reports.file_id; ORDER BY created_at DESC], update(id, data) [for doctor review fields].

Create Backend/src/db/stats.db.js: exports getDashboardCounts(todayStart, todayEnd) [single query with 5 subquery counts], getTodayRevenue(todayStart, todayEnd) [SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payments WHERE is_deleted=false AND paid_at>=$1 AND paid_at<=$2], getTotalRevenue() [SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payments WHERE is_deleted=false], getCategoryBreakdown() [SELECT treatment_category_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM appointments WHERE is_deleted=false AND treatment_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY treatment_category_id].

Create Backend/src/db/index.js: re-exports all db modules for convenience: `module.exports = { clinicDb: require('./clinic.db'), userDb: require('./user.db'), patientDb: require('./patient.db'), appointmentDb: require('./appointment.db'), treatmentCategoryDb: require('./treatment-category.db'), clinicalRecordDb: require('./clinical-record.db'), invoiceDb: require('./invoice.db'), paymentDb: require('./payment.db'), fileDb: require('./file.db'), aiReportDb: require('./ai-report.db'), statsDb: require('./stats.db'), notificationDb: require('./notification.db'), auditLogDb: require('./audit-log.db') };`

IMPORTANT for all db files: Use `const supabase = require('../config/supabase');` at the top. For errors, check the `error` field returned by Supabase operations and throw with `throw new Error(error.message)`. For INSERT...RETURNING, use `.insert([data]).select().single()` to get the inserted row back. Column names in PostgreSQL are snake_case (patient_id, clinic_id, is_deleted, etc.) — all Mongoose camelCase field names must be converted.
acceptance_criteria: Backend/src/db/ directory contains: index.js, clinic.db.js, user.db.js, patient.db.js, appointment.db.js, treatment-category.db.js, clinical-record.db.js, invoice.db.js, payment.db.js, file.db.js, ai-report.db.js, stats.db.js, notification.db.js, audit-log.db.js.
No Mongoose imports in any file under Backend/src/db/.
clinicDb.getDefaultClinic() returns the clinic row from Supabase or creates one.
patientDb.create() does NOT include patient_number in the insert payload; reads it back from RETURNING *.
appointmentDb.create() does NOT include appointment_number in the insert payload; reads it back from RETURNING *.
paymentDb.create() does NOT include receipt_number in the insert payload; reads it back from RETURNING *.
invoiceDb.create() does NOT include invoice_number in the insert payload; reads it back from RETURNING *.
verification: node -e "const { clinicDb } = require('./src/db'); clinicDb.getDefaultClinic().then(c => console.log('clinic id:', c.id)).catch(e => console.error(e));" run from Backend/ — must print a UUID without error (requires SUPABASE env vars and migration SQL applied)

node -e "const { userDb } = require('./src/db'); userDb.findByEmail('admin@dwarkadental.com').then(u => console.log('user:', u ? u.name : 'not found')).catch(e => console.error(e));" — must print a name or 'not found' (not a module error)
findings: All 15 files created successfully. (1) Backend/src/utils/isValidUUID.js: exports isValidUUID() using UUID regex; verified returns true for valid UUID and false for invalid/empty. (2) Backend/src/db/clinic.db.js: getDefaultClinic() queries clinics table and creates a row (with flat address columns address_line1, address_city, address_state, address_zip, address_country) if none exists (handles PGRST116 not-found code). (3) Backend/src/db/user.db.js: exports findByEmail (includes password_hash via select), findById, findDoctors, findAllStaff, createUser, updateUser, updateLastLogin. (4) Backend/src/db/treatment-category.db.js: exports findAll (ILIKE search, is_active filter, sort), findById, findByCode, create, update, toggleActive, upsertByCode (uses onConflict clinic_id,code). (5) Backend/src/db/patient.db.js: exports findAll (with JOINs to users and treatment_categories, ILIKE search across 5 columns, pagination, count), findById, findByPatientNumber, create (no patient_number in insert), update, softDelete. (6) Backend/src/db/appointment.db.js: exports findAll (with JOINs + patient is_deleted filter in both query and post-fetch filter), findById, findByPatient, findRemindersToSend, create (no appointment_number), updateStatus, softDelete, bulkSoftDeleteByPatient, checkOverlap (uses lt/gt for overlap detection and NOT IN cancelled/rescheduled/completed/missed). (7) Backend/src/db/clinical-record.db.js: exports findByPatient, findById, create (dental_chart as JS array for JSONB), update. (8) Backend/src/db/invoice.db.js: exports create (no invoice_number), createWithItems (sequential insert of invoice then items with invoice_id FK). (9) Backend/src/db/payment.db.js: exports findAll (JOIN to patients), findByPatient, create (no receipt_number), softDelete, getRevenueSummary (aggregated in JS since Supabase JS client lacks GROUP BY). (10) Backend/src/db/file.db.js: exports create, findById. (11) Backend/src/db/ai-report.db.js: exports create, findByPatient (LEFT JOIN files), update. (12) Backend/src/db/stats.db.js: exports getDashboardCounts (5 parallel HEAD queries with count:exact), getTodayRevenue, getTotalRevenue, getCategoryBreakdown (aggregated in JS). (13) Backend/src/db/notification.db.js: exports create, findByRecipient. (14) Backend/src/db/audit-log.db.js: exports create. (15) Backend/src/db/index.js: re-exports all 13 db modules. All files use CommonJS, zero Mongoose imports, all syntax validated with node --check. Note: runtime verification of clinicDb.getDefaultClinic() requires SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Backend/.env and migration SQL applied in Supabase — environment not configured in this workspace.
